featured_reviews.name: Tanveer Waghu
featured_reviews.review_text:
Oh boy.... where to start.  This place is nightmare for a customer.  I totally agree to Afsha's review that staff is not only uncooperative but very rude... I was surprised that the owner is worst among them.  I purchased very good amount of gold from them and the way owner treated me after showing my displeasement (due to incorrect information given by the staff),  was really shocking.  His attitude was like he doesn't care... its like he is doing a huge favour on you selling gold to you.

The issue was mode of payment... the staff, her name is Lubna, gave me piecemeal information on what kind of payment they accept... Actually they have just one mode of payment which is bank transfer.

If you order your design, they will take full payment even it takes over a month (I was surprise as none of other Jeweler does it).

Anyway... don't want to spoil my mood again... PLEASE DO NOT GO TO MINAGOLD .... THERE ARE PLENTY JEWELERS in Mumbai with very good customer service.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
We regret not being able to meet your expectations with regards to payment terms. Deliveries are subject to realization of cheque & the amounts reflecting in our bank account. This is a standard practice across all Jewellery & other Retail stores across the country.

We accept Cash, Old Gold & Digital Payments subject to statutory limits while complying with Indian Government Income Tax regulations. As a matter of fact, you did use all the above mentioned forms of payments.

Due to Gold Price volatility, we book gold rates at a minimum of 75% advance. Our esteemed clients also have the option of giving nominal advance & pay as per gold rates prevailing on the date of delivery.
Our policies, fair & transparent, are clearly mentioned on the Order Forms, Receipts & are also prominently displayed in the Store. The same are also explained to our esteemed clients. These policies are common across jewellers in the country.

Being a fourth generation family run business, we are driven by golden values of Truth, Integrity & Honesty. It has always been our endeavour to give to our esteemed clients, unique & exclusively designed, meticulously crafted, hallmarked & certified Jewellery at reasonable prices. Our 35 years in the current location would not have been possible without the support, encouragement and faith of all our esteemed clients who keep coming back to us for which we are always grateful.

We respect our customers immensely & treat them honourably. However, as a responsible employer, it is also our duty to stand up for our mostly female staff, who work tirelessly to adorn our customers. If a customer uses foul language, misbehaves or disrespects them, we will protect them like their parents would, even if it means losing business. We would never want to make profit at the cost of our employees’ honour & self-respect.

We therefore offered you a full refund when you insisted on Delivery against cheque payment, even though your order was customised as per your specifications on a priority basis, within 3 weeks instead of standard 4 weeks.

We sincerely hope that you will like our jewellery and are able to cherish it for a very long time.

featured_reviews.review_text:
The designs R beautiful but the craftmanship is poor. The quality of earring R poor & fall off easily. Extremely rude store manager, non responsive management
-      -      -      -     -     -     -
Team,

I left the product with u over 7 months ago, I DO NOT EXPECT A REFUND OR ANY FINANCIAL OR NON-FINANCIAL COMPENSATION.

There R so many false claims in Ur statement above-

“Had U not abused & threatened our staff.....we would have let this go.”

I NEVER ABUSED Ur staff – check CCTV footage.

I never threatened to use FB to get free products – I had been in touch with Ur owner Ms Dhriti Goenka on FB & she had mentioned twice on 22/11/2017 & then again on 8/4/2018 that she will get back to me with a solution. (See pics)

on 14/6/18 - Since the store manager’s response was different, after waiting 30 mins at the store sans a resolution, pending for 7 months, I requested to speak to the owner.

The store didnt connect me to her even though they spoke to her for over 30 mins while I waited. I requested for an email address for feedback – even this was denied – It’s unfair to not disclose a  business email – check Ur cctv this is exactly how things unfolded.

U left me no choice but to get in touch with DHRITI through Ur FB page. Please confirm with Ur team & check Ur CCTV footage.

"We happily agreed to a replacement & but U omitted to tell us that U had lost the product & wanted a new pair for free."

This is a BIG FAT LIE – please find below a screenshot of a conversation from November 2017 when I clearly mentioned that one screw is misplaced to Ur owner.

"We extended our full cooperation….different intention & purpose"

If I had the intention of getting free product worth Rs 350/- from U I would not leave product of ~Rs8000/- in Ur possession for 7 months. I was merely looking to make sure that I get a good product that doesnt repeatedly fall off - please read my message to Dhriti on advice on how to avoid this in the future – NO RESPONSE!

If my intention was “different” I would not have told Ur managers to keep the earrings worth ~8000/- without expecting a refund. I would rather incur that loss than use a defective product for my child.

Besides this let me state my side here since U R claiming that I am harassing U

1.	I bought a pair of earrings for my daughter from Ur store.  Specifically asked for a screw that doesnt open or hurt her - manager assured me it was safe & secure.
2.	I  made my child wear them, not convinced that they were proper I rushed her to Ur store where Ur manager checked them personally & reassured me that “this is how they R, don’t worry they will not fall off” – Despite my apprehensions I took her word for it only to find that the screw fell off within the SAME WEEK
3.	Ms Dhriti, the owner, happened to post on a very popular social media group about br& & I sent her a Private Message – enclosed she assured me that she will look into it & try to provide a replacement.
4.	I would have been fine if she would have gotten back to me & politely explained why the product didn’t work &/or the brands limitations – instead I was in a loop for over 7 months coordinating between her & the store manager sporadically & both had a very different tone & solution.
5.	Finally after 7 months, I gave up on ur brand when just an email address for feedback was refused.

As to Ur claim that I am using different accounts to harass U – kindly note as a consumer I have the right to review Ur product – I have done that on two platforms – FB & Google – both with accounts that R over 10 years old & not created to harass U. Request U to please check U facts before U slander someone. These reviews were written after trying to resolve this politely over 7 months.

Anyhow let bygones be bygones!  The product with U and I dont expect anything in return.

Request u to confirm that the product has been in ur custody for over 7 months & at last communication has been returned without asking for a refund.

All the best - hope my experience is just an exception in ur quality of product and service

SInce 1912, Zaverchand Bhurabhai Zaveri has been Manufacturing and Retailing Niche Jewellery.
Located at Hughes Road And Vile Parle, our Stores Have a wide range of jewelry, from everyday wear to bridal jewelry.
Zaverchand Bhurabhai Zaveri Manufactures its jewelry, empowering customers to customize jewelry as per their desire.
Better Know as #TheHouseOfZBZ, we have a legacy of over one hundred years in fine Jewellery.
We at ZBZ put the interests of our clients first; not only do we advise the right jewelry suited for them, but we aim to make it a memorable experience for them to possess jewelry.
Ps-
Our Jewelry Firm is not associated in any way with the Silver store, which coincidentally shares a similar name (Zaverchand Bhurabhai)
